description: BCBSAZ Health Choice non-discrimination notice, multi-language insert, page 4: the Farsi tagline (#122). InDesign draws each connected piece of a word left to right but the pieces in logical order, so pdfium's reversal of the right-to-left run scrambled the letters.

contains: توجھ: اگر بھ زبان فارسی صحبت
خدمات زبانی رایگان بھ شما ارائھ میشود.
assertions.why: The tagline in logical order, as pdftotext reads its text layer after NFKC.

assertions.xfail: 'تماس', the last word of the tagline's first row, is drawn left of the phone number and is read before the row, at the end of the Nepali tagline above.
